snippet.title: Katherine Jackson Breaks Silence on Michael’s Surgery, Sexuality, and Allegations | the detail.
snippet.description:
In these powerful and emotional interviews, Katherine Jackson, the mother of the legendary Michael Jackson, speaks openly about some of the most controversial topics surrounding her son: his plastic surgery, sexuality, and the child abuse allegations that forever changed his life and legacy.

Katherine Jackson sets the record straight on long-standing rumors about Michael’s appearance, including his nose surgeries and his struggle with vitiligo, the skin condition that changed his complexion. She also addresses the cruel nickname “Wacko Jacko” created by the media, and why she believes Michael was unfairly targeted at the height of his career.

Most importantly, Katherine passionately defends Michael against the child molestation allegations, revisiting the 1993 case, the settlement, and later accusations. She shares how Michael assured her of his innocence, why she never doubted him for a second, and why she believes the media and money-hungry individuals were determined to destroy him.

snippet.title: Katherine Jackson Breaks Silence on Michael’s Childhood and Abuse Claims | the detail.
snippet.description:
In these emotional and revealing interviews, Katherine Jackson, mother of the King of Pop, opens up about Michael Jackson’s lost childhood, his early rise to fame, and the ongoing discussions around child abuse claims against her husband and Michael's father, Joe Jackson.

Katherine reflects on their humble beginnings in Gary, Indiana, Michael's natural musical talent early on, and how he found comfort and freedom on stage. She also addresses how strict parenting shaped Michael’s life, whether Joe Jackson’s discipline was truly abuse, and how Michael himself came to terms with his childhood struggles.

From memories of Michael dancing to the rhythm of a washing machine as a baby, to his first breathtaking performances that moved his grandfather to tears, this rare insight from Katherine offers a deeper understanding of the man behind the legend.
